h: Silent Holiness and the Hidden Power of Incense

p: are in secret and in silence;
and the Levi'im are to raise the voice.
the Kohanim are in silence and in secret,
and wine is forbidden to them,
for wine is to raise the voice, etc.;
is done in the Heichal in silence,
from between the Ulam and the Mizbe'ach
at the time of the offering of incense."
let a thing done in silence come
and atone for a deed done in silence";
Now this needs to be understood:
'You have killed the people of Hashem'";
so why does it call it
"let a thing done in silence come,"
that the matter of the ketores
is that one mixes into it
which indicates the sinners of Yisrael,
that they too will give a good fragrance
when they are in one band
these that are ordered and come
from the six days of creation,"
and only a Ches is added in it,
and in truth it is only
And when there will be revealed
that already in the first Maamar
which comes out from within darkness"
then "they shall be whitened like snow."
and this is why the ketores is called
is a deed of silence and secret;
for it is stated in the Gemara
'A tongue that speaks great things,' etc."
And this too is a matter of secret,
to correspond to these three grave sins,
that is, that this is the root of evil,
and it is the secret of the kelipah;
for the first deed of the Nachash
was that it spoke lashon hara
and this is its root of evil;
"Who is the man who desires life,
who loves days to see good"
that is, the light that is good,
for then he will be saved
from all the corruption of the Nachash,
And this is what it says:
"and atone for a deed done in silence."

p: And this is the matter of
that he gave him his secret,
to offer a pan of ketores
at the time of a plague
So why did the Gemara bring
"And he put on the ketores, etc."?
Also, what is the point of
and even the Angel of Death
And from this Moshe Rabbeinu knew
that the sinners of Yisrael too
and when there will be revealed
these that are ordered and come
from the six days of creation";
and "let a thing done in silence come
and atone for a deed done in silence."
And this is why they brought
for the Gemara does not explain
as is written in the Mechilta,
that it did not want to listen to him
and he asked Hakadosh Baruch Hu;
was not commanded by Hakadosh Baruch Hu,
but Moshe did it on his own;
as is written in the holy Zohar
although he atoned for the people,
he needed to hold it back;
that is, that through the ketores,
from the six days of creation"
for he rectified all the power
of the Angel of Death and the Nachash,
before the corruption of the Nachash.
And this is the matter of
what is written in the holy Zohar
and guarded from every evil thing.
"The secret of Hashem is with those who fear Him" (Tehillim 25:14).
in the name of a certain Rav,
"And in the midst of holy ones be praised":
"by the mouth," "by the lips," "by the tongue";
it is only "in the midst of holy ones,"
And this is so too with the Kohen:
and he is in secret and in silence.
that at the meal of Shabbos night
and likewise at the morning meal of Shabbos
similar to what the holy Zohar writes
That is, at the two meals
the holiness of Yitzchak and Avraham,
therefore there was instituted at them
for wine is "to raise the voice."
"And they shall sanctify the Holy One of Yaakov,
and revere the God of Yisrael,"
and it is hidden and secret,
like "in the midst of holy ones,"
And this is the meaning of
"The secret of Hashem is with those who fear Him":
is a secret with those who fear Him;
and as is written in the holy Zohar
"'Her husband is known in the gates' (Mishlei 31:23):
who is known and cleaved to
according to what he measures in his heart,
And therefore at this third meal,
who is a chariot for the Name Havayah,
"the secret of Hashem is with those who fear Him,"
is in silence and in secret,
